title: Tool library dialog: U4b Properties summary, picker out of the shape window, Body section

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Goal: Finish the U4 surface moves of the tool library redesign (#3663) that the PR for #3895 held back.

The PR for #3895 adds the assembly group (holder, gauge length, stick-out) to the tool library window. It does not do these three items from the #3895 file list:

1. `tool_settings.rs`: the tool Properties page becomes a summary with an "Edit in tool library" button.
2. `tool_profile_page.rs` `editor`: the holder picker leaves the tool shape window. The shape window keeps the drawn profile and the cutter.
3. `tool_library_dialog/assembly_group.rs`: a folded "Body" section (`tool_body_assembly_page::section`, `tool_body_page::body_section`) and the stand-in `holder_d` and `holder_len` when there is no body. This needs a window-owned body draft first, because `tool_body_ui` is still the draft of Properties.

Why held: items 1 and 2 move about ten tests that drive the shape window picker and the Properties holder rows (`tool_holder.rs`, `tool_holder_reference.rs`, `structural::tool_editor_structure`, `page_layout_windows::layout_window_tool_shape`, `tool_properties::tool_settings_form_a_label_left_grid_in_collapsible_groups`). Item 3 would mix the two body drafts. The decision is in `docs/decisions/3895-tool-holder-group.md`.

Commands: `SetToolBody` paths and `ChangeTool`. Nothing new.

Done means:
- The Properties page of a tool is a summary with an "Edit in tool library" button.
- The shape window has no holder picker.
- The window shows the Body section from its own body draft.
- The tests move and are not deleted. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` does not go down.

Suggested labels (I cannot set labels): `enhancement`, `area:ui`, `P4` (part of the maintainer's tool library redesign), `effort:high` (safety floor: holder geometry feeds the collision checks), `source:agent`.
